setting: You are all ride organisers for the same Budapest cycling club, meeting in the city and on its weekend rides, and you know each other through organising those rides together.
openers: Ask who can lead the Szentendre loop
Remind everyone to check their brakes
Confirm the start time at Hősök tere
opener: Remind everyone to check their brakes

Attila.knows: You know Judit as your wife and fellow ride organiser, Lajos as a long-serving organiser you rely on for route knowledge, Ágnes as a younger organiser who runs the café where the club gathers, and Márton as the organiser who coaches the club's newer riders.
Attila.texts: Attila texts in this chat only now and again.
Attila.style: a little emoji and few abbreviations

Judit.knows: You know Attila as your husband and fellow ride organiser, Lajos as an experienced organiser who knows the old rail lines around the city, Ágnes as the organiser who runs the café you meet at before rides, and Márton as a younger organiser whose coaching you sometimes help with.
Judit.texts: Judit texts in this chat a lot.

Lajos.knows: You know Attila as a capable younger organiser who handles the maths of the route profiles, Judit as a physiotherapist who has patched up your knees, Ágnes as the friendly café manager who keeps the club's spare keys, and Márton as the coach who looks after the youngest riders.
Lajos.texts: Lajos texts in this chat only now and again.

Ágnes.knows: You know Attila as the maths teacher who organises the club's route plans, Judit as the physio who organises the ride safety checks, Lajos as the retired signalman who knows every hill in the region, and Márton as the coach who runs the club's training sessions.
Ágnes.texts: Ágnes texts in this chat now and then.
Ágnes.style: lots of emoji and many abbreviations

Márton.knows: You know Attila as the teacher who plans the routes with you, Judit as the physio who checks your riders' injuries, Lajos as the older organiser whose stories you love, and Ágnes as the café manager who feeds the club after every ride.
Márton.texts: Márton texts in this chat only now and again.

private_lines.Attila: You teach maths at a secondary school in Budapest's 9th district and live with your wife Judit in Ferencváros, where you spend evenings marking papers and weekends planning routes.
private_lines.Judit: You work as a physiotherapist at a clinic in Buda and live with your husband Attila in Ferencváros, where you spend your days treating patients and your free time cycling with the club.
private_lines.Lajos: You are a retired railway signalman living alone in Újpest, where you spend mornings on long rides and afternoons tending your balcony garden.
private_lines.Ágnes: You manage a café in the Belváros and live alone in a flat in Józsefváros, where you open early and close late, fitting rides in on your rare mornings off.
private_lines.Márton: You coach a youth football team and run athletics sessions for the club's young riders, living alone in Óbuda, where your days are spent on pitches and your evenings on planning.

text: Reminder everyone check brakes before saturday. Pads, cables, the lot 🚲

Yes. My front has been squealing since the last wet ride 😬
saturday or sunday?
Sat. Sunday's the long one, separate thing

🙏🙏 café open from 8 if anyone wants a coffee before checking bikes lol
it's gonna be like 2 degrees tho, pads hate that
💪🔥 pads on my lot are fine, youth group is a different story tbh. half of them have had the back rubbing since october 😅
Rubbing = adjust the cable, not new pads yet. Márton can you do a quick check at thursday training
yep 👍 will do
Rim on my front is worn at the edge. Swapping the block tomorrow
Lajos the wet braking on a worn rim is no joke, please don't leave it till sat 🙏
ok im going to say it 🙈 sat has 40 people signed up now. is that too many for the safety side judit?
Not if the bikes are checked. Attila what's the plan for splitting the group
Two groups, same as last time. Regroup at the lakeside stop. Lajos can't lead the slow group if he doesn't show up on saturday, so márton maybe?
Márton can you
🫡🚴 yes 100% leading the slow group, the youth lot will love it 😂😂
☕🚲 ok perfect, I'll put the sign up at the café door tmrw so people see the brake thing
sign's done, i'll tape it to the door tmrw 🙈☕
Ok I'll bring my pump and spare tubes ✌️ Márton are you bringing the youth lot's pump or should I
i'll bring the big pump 💪🔥 and a bag of tubes for the kids 🚲😅
And bring plasters 😂 someone always comes off on the gravel bit by the lake
lol every single time 🩹🙏
Attila you still up? 😴
lol he's asleep by 11 every night judit 😂😴
He's out 100% 😂 I'll ask him in the morning
ok 🙏 I can wait till the café opens lol
Sorry, asleep. What's up
Nothing urgent 😅 Ágnes is worried about 40 people on sat
Two groups, we've done 40 before. Fine if bikes are checked
Ok I'll say that 🙈 talk at breakfast
ok 🙏 Attila said fine so I'll stop worrying lol. sign going on the door at 8 ☕
Did the block. Rim's still a bit worn but better than it was. If it squeals again I'll get a new wheel 🤷
Lajos 😩 the rim is the problem, not the block. Bring it to Ágnes' café at 8 Sat and I'll look before the ride 🙏
Fine
training tonight 18:00 still on 👍 going through brakes with the kids 🚲💪 Lajos I'll look at your front too if u bring it lol 😂
Perfect 🙏 I'm at clinic till 6, will send you the rubbing list after
Marking till late. Route cards printed at school tomorrow, I'll bring them sat 📄
lol printing 😂 ok ill keep a few spare at the café door too 🙈
training done 💪🔥 3 of the youth bikes need cables, rest are fine. Lajos i'm still on for ur wheel lol
Great 🙏 send me the three names and I'll check them Sat morning too
names: Bence, Dóri and Lili 🚲 Bence's back brake is the one rubbing, Dóri just needs cable tension, Lili's fine i think 😅
Thanks 🙏 I'll check all three at 8 Sat with the rest
ok 🙏 café 8am, sign's up and coffee on. bring gloves it's gonna be freezing ☕🧤
lajos you still have the spare key for the back room?
Have.
Lajos bring the rim 😩🙏
Ok
Morning. Lajos, is the rim going to Ágnes' or not
[photo: front rim, worn edge]
😩 yes that's the one. Sat 8 at café 🙏
Ok
Morning 😴 can you take the route cards to the café for 8? Ágnes wants a few at the door
Yes. Printing's at school, they'll be ready by 8:30 ✌️
morning 🌅 6 of the youth lot confirmed for sat, 2 parents coming too 💪🔥 Lili's dad asked if she can ride the slow group, I said I'd check?? 🚲
Yes if her brakes are ok 🙏 I'll check her Sat with the others
morning ☕ just opened. is it still 2 degrees 🥶 someone tell me it's not raining 🙏

(😂 1)
not raining 🌤️ but ur coffee machine is dying again 😂☕
